title: Injective proper-support restriction with exact fibre range
statement: In the setting of lem-cbc-proper-support-geometric-stalk-image, the induced restriction map ((pointSmallEtale y).sheafFiber.map i ≫ c.app F) on the geometric stalk is injective, and an element of its target lies in its linear range if and only if it has proper support on the geometric fibre.

proof.text: Represent a geometric-stalk element on a pointed étale neighbourhood and restrict it to the fibre. The inverse-image germ formula and proper-support locality show that the resulting support is proper. Conversely, shrink a properly supported fibre section to a quasi-compact open, give its support the reduced induced closed structure, compactify the open immersion by Nagata, and glue the section with zero outside its proper support. The resulting representative lies in G by hG and restricts to the original fibre section. The same zero-extension argument shows that a stalk element restricting to zero is already zero after refinement, proving injectivity.
